Name: Recycle Your Clothes
Author: Suntooth
Description:
[size=3]Quite simply, this mod lets you recycle any shirts, pants, hats, or boots in the Recycling Machine, receiving one Cloth in return. All three categories (shirts & pants; hats; boots) can be individually toggled in the config.[/size]
